title: Looking to Jesus
speaker: Jonathan Baird
summary: What is distracting you from Jesus this morning? The Holy Spirit isn't here to beat you up, but to help you lay it aside and run to him.
exhortation: What is distracting you from Jesus this morning? Is it your own sin? Your finances? I know those distract me quite often. Is it your work? Apathy, a feeling that you just don't care? Pride, fear or worry? Maybe you're not sure. You just feel like you're in a funk.
Then take some time this morning and ask the Holy Spirit for help. Is he putting his finger on something? Is something coming to mind that you know is hindering your view of Jesus?

The Holy Spirit isn't here to beat us up. He is here to help us lay everything aside and run to Jesus. So as we worship, let the Holy Spirit do his work in your heart. You don't need to be afraid, resist or run away, because he is kind and gentle and here to help. This is where we find the power to overcome: when we humble ourselves and obey the Holy Spirit, because in our weakness he is strong.
prayer: Lord, may that be our gaze: you on the cross, bearing our shame, our sin and our punishment, dying our death. Remind us of that as we go through this day. If you did not spare your Son, and he did not resist the cross but took it willingly for our sake, how much more will you provide for us today?
Fill us with faith as we look at what you've done for us, faith for today that you are with us every step of the way. We pray this in your precious name, Jesus. Amen.
